description.value: The Lillooet Area Library Association operates this public library serving the communities of Lillooet, Gold Bridge, and Shalalth in the Fraser Canyon region. It functions as a broad community hub offering a Library of Things, device lending, digital media access, and a range of adult and youth programs. For touring cyclists passing through Lillooet — a key waypoint on the Duffey Lake Road corridor — it offers computers, Wi-Fi, and community resources in a welcoming public space.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the phone number (250-256-7944) and email (director@lillooetlibrary.ca) matching OSM. The website lists 'Computers & Internet' as an in-library service, corroborating the OSM internet_access=wlan tag, supporting Wi-Fi as true. None of the cycling-specific required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so all three remain null.
concerns: The contact page was truncated before the full street address could be confirmed, so address match with OSM (930 Main Street) is unverified.
All three required WWC criteria are null — the listing should not be included until at least bike parking and washrooms are confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a legitimate public amenity and community hub in a key cycling waypoint (Lillooet), but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify before including.

wow_evidence: Community library with Library of Things; ordinary intrinsic delight.
blurb: Lillooet's public library, hub of the three-branch Lillooet Area Library Association.
